states.name: Dracula
states.title: The King of Vampires
states.description:
Six months ago, a lone noble took up residence in the old castle on the hill. Calling herself a count, she was lighting up the castle each night to host lavish evening balls. All who gathered there would find themselves intoxicated by her elegance and beauty.

But—No one knows how many of the invited guests would live to see the dawn.

states.name: Dracula
states.title: The King of Vampires
states.description:
These evening parties are not gatherings for social exchange, but hunting grounds where humans are sorted and selected.
Most are gradually drained of blood to provide sustenance for her and her kin. A chosen few are given some of Dracula's own blood and transformed into her servants.

Despite being an immortal ruler of the night, she fears her weakness to sunlight. And so she has been moving from one lair to the next before her secrets could get exposed.

states.name: Dracula
states.title: The King of Vampires
states.description:
She has been captive to the memory of one woman for many years, even now.
The woman she had once believed loved her in return. The only woman in the world she had ever loved from the depths of her heart.

But that woman betrayed her, and sought to take Dracula's life.

Even now, there is an old wound in her chest, left there by a stake driven through her heart. It has been years since that fateful day, and the wound is no longer visible from the outside.
And yet, deep within, it still lingers there unhealed.
